I did not push: your replay note says the runner pushes after its own checks, so I followed that over the generic "git push" line.

The other 7 are listed in `dataset/drops/sleep-105.tsv`: birthdays, a seminar notice already on file, the Rice SAS/SPSS licence thread, the MCI phone instructions, the JDRF donation, the benefits FAQ and a party invitation.

- The Baylor visit on 15-16 Nov and the Atlanta trip on 31 Oct.

I created files for Claude Philoche, Mario De La Ossa, Bill White, Eric Moon and Mark Breese, whose fifth message came this week, and for Doug Gilbert-Smith and Therese Candella, whose files were overdue from earlier weeks.
